banner.text: Demo using synthetic data. This tool does not decide anyone's eligibility.

disclaimer.general: This is a demonstration with synthetic data. Please confirm details with your Booth Level Officer or on the official Election Commission of India website.

citizen.title: Check your entry in the roll
citizen.intro: Enter your details exactly as they appear on your voter slip. We only show what the roll records; nothing you type is saved.
citizen.name: Your name
citizen.epic_hint: For this demo, numbers start with VGX, for example VGX1234567

errors.part_no_invalid: Part number should be a whole number, such as 17.
errors.rate_limited: Many searches were made in a short time. Please wait a minute and try again.
errors.network: We could not reach the service. Please check your connection and try again.
errors.generic: Something did not work as expected. Please try again in a moment.

PRESENT.title: Your name is in the final roll
PRESENT.body: Your entry appears in the final roll for this part. No action is needed.

REMOVED.title: Your entry is not in the final roll
REMOVED.body: Your entry appeared in the draft roll but is not in the final roll. This can happen for several reasons, and it can be reviewed.

ADDED.title: Your name has been added
ADDED.body: Your entry is new in the final roll for this part.

NOT_FOUND.title: We could not find a matching entry
NOT_FOUND.body: Please check the spelling of both names and the part number, or try again using your EPIC number.

AMBIGUOUS.title: More than one entry matches
AMBIGUOUS.body: To protect privacy we do not list them. Please search again using your EPIC number.

reasons.ABSENT: Recorded as not found at the address during house-to-house verification
reasons.SHIFTED: Recorded as having moved to a different address

placeholder.body: This section is being built. Please check back later.

common.load_error: We could not load this information. Please try again.
common.flag_disclaimer: Flags are prompts for field verification. They do not establish wrongdoing or eligibility.

heatmap.title: Booths by risk score
heatmap.intro: Each tile is one booth. Darker tiles have a higher risk score. Booths with flags have a bold border and a flag mark. Select a tile to open the booth.

table.title: All booths
table.caption: Booth list. Use the column buttons to sort.

metric.house_cluster_share: Share from a few house numbers

finalize.title: Finalize and record report
finalize.intro: This saves a report of the current review and records its fingerprint (hash) on the local ledger so anyone can check it later.
finalize.pending_note: Some flags are still pending. You can still finalize; the report will show them as pending.
finalize.error_ledger: The report ledger could not be reached right now. Nothing was recorded. Please try again in a moment.
finalize.error_rejected: The service could not accept this request: {{message}}
finalize.error_network: We could not reach the trust service. Please check the connection and try again.
finalize.error_generic: Something did not work as expected. Please try again.

booth.title: Booth {{part}}
booth.not_found: This booth was not found in the current audit.
booth.no_flags: No flags were raised for this booth.

review.label: Review decision
review.error: The decision could not be saved and has been undone. Please try again.
